title: Senior Plant Director
text: As a Senior Plant Director here at Honeywell Aerospace, you will be responsible for leading the operations and performance of our manufacturing plant. You will create and implement strategies to optimize plant operations, improve productivity, and reduce costs. Ensuring compliance with safety regulations and promoting a culture of safety throughout the plant will be a key responsibility. You will collaborate with cross-functional leadership to drive continuous improvement initiatives and implement best practices. Monitoring key performance indicators and implementing corrective actions to address any deviations from targets will be crucial. Additionally, you will manage and help create the plant budget and resources effectively to achieve financial goals
